endpoints.name: Initiate Mandate Setup
endpoints.purpose: Standalone USSD/WhatsApp/API-partner registration endpoint for auto-debit requests that are not submitted as CBS-only FQIP applications for admin approval. The API validates the customer identity and target account, initiates Hubtel wallet preapproval, creates the FCL mandate, and returns both FCL mandate and Hubtel preapproval references. For CBS-only customers, use `mandate.targetType=ACCOUNT` with `mandate.targetAccountNumber`; if omitted, the resolved identity account is used as the target. `mandate.amount` is the recurring debit amount. `mandate.frequency` is optional and defaults to monthly when omitted. Response includes `mandateReference`, `mandateStatus`, `preapproval.clientReferenceId`, `preapproval.hubtelPreApprovalId`, and `nextAction` (`VERIFY_OTP` or `NONE`). For FQIP/GOAL SAVINGS, use `Initiate Preapproval` + `Verify Preapproval OTP`, then submit the GOAL SAVINGS application with `autoDebit` instead.

endpoints.name: Initiate Preapproval
endpoints.purpose: Starts only the Hubtel direct-debit consent flow and sends OTP to the customer's MoMo wallet. This endpoint does not create an FCL mandate by itself. For FQIP/GOAL SAVINGS, call this first, then call `Verify Preapproval OTP`; after verification returns `preapprovalStatus=APPROVED`, submit the CBS-only `Submit GOAL SAVINGS Application` request with the returned `clientReferenceId` and `hubtelPreApprovalId` in its `autoDebit` block. Body fields: `identity.clientAccountNumber`, `identity.clientCustomerId`, or `identity.clientPhoneNumber` identifies the bank customer. Account number takes precedence, then customer ID, then phone number. `preapproval.customerMsisdn` is the MoMo wallet to debit; `preapproval.channel` is the mobile-money channel, for example `mtn-gh`. Store `clientReferenceId` and `hubtelPreApprovalId` from the response. Fresh responses usually have `preapprovalStatus=PENDING`; response objects can also include `amount` when supplied.
